gap_table.what: dorsal fin small, stubby or knob-like, usually on a hump (arched back)
gap_table.cause: view missing from the training renders (coverage < 0.5)
gap_table.factory: hump + small, stubby, knob-like or hooked fins (the rig's fin is a tall clean blade on a back with no hump)

gap_table.what: back or peduncle with no dorsal fin in view (fin behind the back, under water or cut off)
gap_table.cause: view missing from the training renders (coverage < 0.5)
gap_table.factory: backs and tail stocks with no fin in view: arched peduncle from behind, flat awash backs, backs in foam

gap_table.what: pectoral fin (raised, slapping, or white flipper on the surface)
gap_table.cause: view missing from the training renders (coverage < 0.5)
gap_table.factory: pectoral fins: raised, slapping, lying white on the surface, with splash; dark top side as well as white

gap_table.what: fluke rising low or rolling out: water pouring / sheeting off, blades near the surface
gap_table.cause: appearance / shape (covered, and right on renders, but wrong on real)
gap_table.factory: flukes rising low / rolling out flat at the surface, water sheeting off, blades half in the water, seen from behind

gap_table.what: head / rostrum / blowholes / chin (head rise, lunge, blow with head only)
gap_table.cause: appearance / shape (covered, and right on renders, but wrong on real)
gap_table.factory: heads: head rise / spyhop / lunge from the front with ventral grooves, rostrum with tubercles, blowholes from the front

gap_table.what: dorsal fin clearly visible, tall / falcate blade on the back
fluke edge-on or side-on: blades seen in profile, single blade, peduncle + fluke in side view
gap_table.factory: flukes seen side-on / single blade raised (tail throw, slap, dive at an angle), with water streams

gap_table.what: belly up, roll, breach, body slap, tail-stock throw seen from the side
gap_table.cause: appearance / shape (covered, and right on renders, but wrong on real)

gap_table.what: dorsal fin only partly out of the water, tip / far or tiny fin, or fin seen end-on
gap_table.factory: fin seen end-on from behind on the arched back (dive), far / small fins, fin partly under water

gap_table.what: fluke raised, seen from behind or in front: both blades spread, clear of the water
gap_table.factory: keep (fluke raised from behind is well covered)

gap_table.what: not a whale or unreadable: splash only, wake, blow only, boat, water
gap_table.factory: not a whale (splash, blow, birds, poles, land) passing the not-whale filter: negatives for the segmentation
